# Human Spearman partial animation pack

Pack 0.6.0 preserves all 40 existing registered poses and adds four locally authored North walk keys from the already-public painted North seed. SE/NE/East walks, SE attack/defeat and all eight idle facings are retained unchanged. North uses four 200ms contact/passing keys, one 800ms loop, the existing body calibration and padded original pivot. Four walk headings, seven attack and seven defeat headings remain missing (18 cells). Page dimensions and the zero team mask are unchanged. No matching 3D master, provider job, held v2 art or state/simulation change is involved.

Selected sources and provenance: `docs/art-direction/human-roster-v1/extracted/spearman/walk/north-local-v1/registration.json`. The full `scripts/build-human-spearman-preview.py` builder replays baseline, NE, East and North stages; individual older append scripts intentionally guard their reviewed construction stage. Independent North source review and exact integration evidence are retained in the owning North slice guide. Ordinary GPU gait, support-foot speed, normal/strategic/crowded appearance and deployed acceptance remain pending. The private process and all iterations are retained by the Human foot art owner.
